scope: Deepening of the existing cold periodic 1D electrostatic PIC, homogeneous isotropic Maxwell collision component, and pure-absorption slab families. No new physical family, quantum calculation, calibrated DSMC time, hard-sphere claim, scattering, or exact PIC energy-conservation claim.

pic.independence: Continuum mode cos(t) follows the independently derived cold-fluid linear equations, with O(amplitude^2) nonlinear scope. Mesh sweep keeps particle coordinates/count and dt fixed (ppc therefore varies explicitly); time sweep keeps mesh and particle coordinates fixed. DOP853 integrates exactly the same particle-grid RHS and is independent only as a time integration algorithm; its max-step sensitivity is measured. Random-load shot-noise ensembles vary only N at fixed mesh, measured at t=0, and are separate from quiet-start mesh/time errors. Analytic E[|mean exp(ix)|^2]=1/N tests particle loading; actual CIC grid mode obeys N E[|rhohat_1/grid|^2]=(2+cos(2*pi/grid))/3. Both normalized mean powers use the predeclared 0.5..1.5 bounds and their RMS reduction uses the same minimum 1.3, validating initial noise rather than evolved-plasma convergence. Gauss diagnostics exclude the real skew derivative's Nyquist null mode and separately bound that charge component.

dsmc.independence: With total momentum zero and sum |v|^2=3N, equilibrium lies on the sphere of dimension D=3(N-1). A particle's e/[3(N-1)/2] has Beta(3/2,3(N-2)/2) CDF; E[vx^4]=9(N-1)/(3N-1), distinct from Maxwell 3. Independent Gaussian projection onto the zero-momentum subspace followed by radius normalization samples this exact equilibrium without collisions. Isotropic random-pair scattering has independently derived E[D_r]=3[(N-2)/(2(N-1))]^r. Empirical CDF errors, fourth moments and anisotropy are assessed using independent-seed standard errors, never iid particle KS p-values. Mean CDF seed standard error across fixed energy points must fall by at least 1.2 from N16 to N256; this measures the fixed independent replicate ensembles, not an all-seed scaling guarantee. 5.5-standard-error diagnostics are finite fixed-ensemble checks, not all-seed or exact confidence guarantees. Rounds are collision operations, not physical time.

radiation.independence: QUADPACK integrates mu*exp(-tau/mu) adaptively and is cross-checked against scipy.special.expn(3,tau), independently of Gauss-Legendre ordinates and upstream marching. Space series uses fixed ordinates and compares exact characteristics at those ordinates; angle series uses exact characteristics to remove spatial error. Analog MC launches flux-weighted mu=sqrt(U), samples an exponential optical path, and records Bernoulli survival: p=2 E3(tau), F=pi*p. Across-seed means, empirical RMSE, exact binomial standard deviations and Clopper-Pearson coverage are recorded separately. Each photon is either absorbed or exits, giving explicit count balance.
